Subject: Hindsight - Overview
Key Details / Answer: Hindsight is an MIT-licensed agent memory system organizing knowledge into World Facts, Experience Facts, Observations, and Mental Models. Uses TEMPR: 4-way hybrid retrieval (semantic, BM25 keyword, graph, temporal). Repo includes API, Control Plane UI, Postgres/pgvector storage, clients (Python, Node/TS, Go, CLI). Companion hindsight-cookbook repo has Hermes, CrewAI, PydanticAI, LiteLLM, Slack/Discord demos.

Subject: Hindsight - Railway Deployment
Key Details / Answer: Railway's official template deploys ghcr.io/vectorize-io/hindsight image; Control Plane UI on port 9999, API on port 8888. Defaults to embedded pg0 Postgres unless external Railway Postgres plugin is attached via HINDSIGHT_API_DATABASE_URL. User needs to verify their Railway dashboard configuration and check LLM provider env vars.

Subject: Hindsight - Hermes Integration
Key Details / Answer: Hermes has a native Hindsight memory provider (old hindsight-hermes plugin deprecated). Setup via 'hermes memory setup', selecting hindsight, then setting HINDSIGHT_API_URL, HINDSIGHT_API_TOKEN, and HINDSIGHT_BANK_ID=avibe-hq in ~/.hermes/.env. Verify with 'hermes memory status'.

Subject: Hindsight - Obsidian Integration
Key Details / Answer: Hindsight Obsidian plugin (installed via BRAT, repo vectorize-io/hindsight-obsidian) syncs vault one-way into a Hindsight bank; chat panel cites source notes. Config fields: API URL, API key, Bank name (avibe-hq), Sync on edit, Remember conversations (off recommended). Headless CLI alternative available for server-hosted vaults. Sync is one-way only (Obsidian remains source of truth); Hindsight does not become an editable second source.

Subject: Hindsight - Alternative Hosting

Subject: Hindsight - Verification Steps
Key Details / Answer: Recommended test sequence: edit note in Obsidian and confirm sync to Control Plane UI; ask Hermes a question answerable only from that note to confirm shared recall; retain a fact from Hermes and confirm it does NOT appear as an editable Obsidian note (confirms one-way boundary).

Subject: Hindsight - Multi-Tenancy
Topic: Can setup be multi-tenant for customers
Key Details / Answer: Yes. Hindsight uses schema-per-tenant/bank isolation; each bank is fully isolated (facts, documents, entities, knowledge graph). No cross-bank queries possible. Built-in multi-tenant extension routes requests to correct Postgres schema; Supabase-JWT variant auto-creates per-user schemas. Recommended pattern: one bank per customer (hard isolation), tags only for soft partitions within one trust domain.

Subject: Hindsight - Railway Storage Limits
Topic: How many banks fit on Hobby plan
Key Details / Answer: No fixed bank-count cap; purely storage/compute-limited since each bank is schema rows, not a separate DB instance. Railway Hobby plan offers up to 48 vCPU/48GB RAM but only 5GB volume storage. Realistic estimate: roughly 10-30+ light-to-medium banks depending on usage, but Hobby lacks connection pooling, autoscaling, and IOPS control, which becomes the bottleneck before storage does. Recommended upgrading to Pro or dedicated Postgres for real paying customers.

Subject: Hindsight - Bank_id Pattern
Key Details / Answer: Official recommended pattern: tenant:{tenant_id}:user:{user_id}:env:{environment}. Derive unique bank_id per user (and tenant if multi-tenant), pass into Hermes before session starts, keep memory_mode and prefetch_method separate from identity decisions, verify isolation by testing that User A's facts are not recallable by User B.

Subject: Hindsight - Hermes Cloning Setup
Key Details / Answer: Hermes cannot literally clone a repo config, but can replicate the pattern via native provider: 'hermes memory setup' selecting hindsight, then 'hermes config set memory.bank_id_template' using the tenant/user/env template. Set HINDSIGHT_API_URL and HINDSIGHT_API_TOKEN. Keep bank_id and memory_mode configuration separate. Run isolation verification test before onboarding real customers. Noted current Hermes limitation: only one active bank_id per agent/session (no cross-bank querying in a single call).
